mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE ATTEMPT_ID=#{attempt} AND PHASE=#{phase}
SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE ACCESS_TYPE=#{access} AND TASK_ID=#{task} ORDER BY ID
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE PARK_ID=#{park} AND INSTANCE_ID=#{instance} AND PHASE=#{phase} AND STATE=#{state} AND ID > #{after} ORDER BY ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE PARK_ID=#{park} AND INSTANCE_ID=#{instance} AND REQUEST_KEY=#{request} AND PHASE=#{phase} ORDER BY ID
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE SET STATE=#{state},EXTERNAL_ID=COALESCE(EXTERNAL_ID,#{external,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),ERROR_CODE=#{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR},UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{id} AND STATE=#{old} AND (EXTERNAL_ID IS NULL OR EXTERNAL_ID=#{external,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE P SET STATE='INTENT',REQUEST_KEY=#{request},PERSON_ID=COALESCE(PERSON_ID,#{person,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{id} AND STATE='PREPARED' AND REQUEST_KEY IS NULL AND (PERSON_ID IS NULL OR PERSON_ID=#{person,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A ON A.TARGET_ID=T.ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_RESOURCE_COORD R ON R.ID=P.RESOURCE_ID WHERE T.ID=P.TARGET_ID AND T.LEASE_TOKEN=P.LEASE_TOKEN AND T.OPERATION_VERSION=P.RESOURCE_GENERATION AND T.STATE IN ('EXECUTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING') AND A.ID=P.ATTEMPT_ID AND A.LEASE_TOKEN=P.LEASE_TOKEN AND A.TASK_ID=P.TASK_ID AND A.STATUS IN ('SUBMITTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING') AND R.BLOCKING_ATTEMPT_ID=P.ATTEMPT_ID AND R.GENERATION=P.RESOURCE_GENERATION)
UPDATE SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE SET PAGE_NO=#{next},UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{id} AND PAGE_NO=#{old} AND STATE='ACCEPTED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_COORD WHERE PARK_ID=#{park} AND SUBJECT_TYPE='STAFF' AND SUBJECT_ID=#{subject}
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A SET EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID=COALESCE(EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID,#{external}),EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID=COALESCE(EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID,#{external}), STATUS=CASE WHEN STATUS='VERIFYING' THEN STATUS ELSE 'WAITING_CONFIRM' END, DISPATCHED_AT=COALESCE(DISPATCHED_AT,SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP)),UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{p.attemptId} AND TARGET_ID=#{p.targetId} AND ATTEMPT_NO=#{p.attemptNo} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{p.leaseToken} AND ACCESS_TYPE=#{p.accessType} AND TASK_ID=#{p.taskId} AND STATUS IN ('SUBMITTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING') AND (EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID IS NULL OR EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID=#{external})AND (EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID IS NULL OR EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID=#{external}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T WHERE T.ID=A.TARGET_ID AND T.PARK_ID=#{p.parkId} AND T.ACCESS_TYPE=#{p.accessType} AND T.LEASE_TOKEN=#{p.leaseToken} AND T.OPERATION_VERSION=#{p.resourceGeneration} AND T.STATE IN ('EXECUTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE P WHERE P.ID=#{p.id} AND P.ATTEMPT_ID=A.ID AND P.TASK_ID=A.TASK_ID AND P.LEASE_TOKEN=A.LEASE_TOKEN AND P.PARK_ID=#{p.parkId} AND P.INSTANCE_ID=#{p.instanceId} AND P.PHASE='DIRECT_SEND' AND P.STATE='INTENT' AND P.SERIAL_NO=#{external}AND P.PHASE='ISC_DOWNLOAD' AND P.STATE='ACCEPTED' AND P.EXTERNAL_ID=#{external})

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET SET STATE=CASE WHEN STATE='VERIFYING' THEN STATE ELSE 'WAITING_CONFIRM' END,DISPATCHED_AT=COALESCE(DISPATCHED_AT,SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP)),UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{p.targetId} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{p.leaseToken} AND OPERATION_VERSION=#{p.resourceGeneration} AND STATE IN ('EXECUTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING')

UPDATE SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK SET ISC_TASK_ID=#{external},PERSON_ID=#{p.personId},STATUS=3,UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=TO_NUMBER(#{p.taskId}) AND DEVICE_CODE=#{p.deviceId} AND CARD_NO=#{p.cardNo} AND STATUS=3 AND (ISC_TASK_ID IS NULL OR ISC_TASK_ID=#{external})

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET SET STATE='VERIFYING',FAILURE_REASON=#{reason},UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{p.targetId} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{p.leaseToken} AND STATE IN ('EXECUTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT P.* FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE P JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T ON T.ID=P.TARGET_ID JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_BATCH B ON B.ID=T.BATCH_ID WHERE P.PARK_ID=#{park} AND P.INSTANCE_ID=#{instance} AND P.STATE='PREPARED' AND P.PHASE IN ('ISC_CONFIG','DIRECT_SEND') AND (B.ACTION='DELETE' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C WHERE C.TARGET_ID=T.ID AND C.SOURCE_ACTION='DELETE'))AND B.ACTION='ADD' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_RESOURCE C WHERE C.TARGET_ID=T.ID AND C.SOURCE_ACTION='DELETE') AND P.ID > #{after} ORDER BY P.ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT SET STATUS='VERIFYING',ERROR_CODE=#{reason},UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{p.attemptId} AND TARGET_ID=#{p.targetId} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{p.leaseToken} AND STATUS IN ('CLAIMED','SUBMITTING','WAITING_CONFIRM','VERIFYING')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE PARK_ID=#{park} AND INSTANCE_ID=#{instance} AND STATE='INTENT' AND UPDATE_TIME < SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP)-INTERVAL '2' MINUTE ORDER BY ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A SET EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID=#{external} WHERE A.ID=#{p.attemptId} AND A.TARGET_ID=#{p.targetId} AND A.ATTEMPT_NO=#{p.attemptNo} AND A.ACCESS_TYPE='ISC' AND A.TASK_ID=#{p.taskId} AND A.LEASE_TOKEN=#{p.leaseToken} AND A.EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE P JOIN SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T ON T.ID=P.TARGET_ID WHERE P.ID=#{p.id} AND P.ATTEMPT_ID=A.ID AND P.TARGET_ID=A.TARGET_ID AND P.TASK_ID=A.TASK_ID AND P.ATTEMPT_NO=A.ATTEMPT_NO AND P.LEASE_TOKEN=A.LEASE_TOKEN AND P.PARK_ID=#{p.parkId} AND T.PARK_ID=P.PARK_ID AND P.INSTANCE_ID=#{p.instanceId} AND P.ACCESS_TYPE=A.ACCESS_TYPE AND P.PHASE='ISC_DOWNLOAD' AND P.STATE IN ('ACCEPTED','FINISHED') AND P.REQUEST_KEY IS NOT NULL AND P.EXTERNAL_ID=#{external})
mapper.select: SELECT PERSON_ID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PERSON_ID FROM ( SELECT PERSON_ID FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE WHERE PARK_ID=#{p.parkId} AND INSTANCE_ID=#{p.instanceId} AND DEVICE_ID=#{p.deviceId} AND SUBJECT_TYPE=#{p.subjectType} AND SUBJECT_ID=#{p.subjectId} AND RESOURCE_ID=#{p.resourceId} AND ACCESS_TYPE='ISC' AND PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ALIAS_VALUE FROM SMT_AUTH_IDENTITY_ALIAS WHERE PARK_ID=#{p.parkId} AND ACCESS_TYPE='ISC' AND DEVICE_ID=#{p.deviceId} AND SUBJECT_TYPE=#{p.subjectType} AND SUBJECT_ID=#{p.subjectId} AND RESOURCE_COORD_ID=#{p.resourceId} AND ALIAS_KIND='PERSON_ID' UNION ALL SELECT PERSON_ID FROM SMT_ISC_DOWN_RECORD WHERE PARK_ID=#{p.parkId} AND DEVICE_CODE=#{p.deviceId} AND CARD_NO=#{p.subjectId} AND DEVICE_TYPE=1 AND SERVICE_TYPE=TO_NUMBER(#{p.serviceType}) AND PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT K.PERSON_ID FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK K JOIN SMT_DEVICE D ON D.ID=K.DEVICE_CODE WHERE D.PARK_ID=#{p.parkId} AND K.DEVICE_CODE=#{p.deviceId} AND K.CARD_NO=#{p.subjectId} AND K.DEVICE_TYPE=1 AND K.SERVICE_TYPE=TO_NUMBER(#{p.serviceType}) AND K.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL )) WHERE ROWNUM<=2
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE SET PERSON_OPERATION_KEY=COALESCE(PERSON_OPERATION_KEY,#{operation}),PERSON_IDENTITY_HASH=COALESCE(PERSON_IDENTITY_HASH,#{hash}),ORG_INDEX_CODE=COALESCE(ORG_INDEX_CODE,#{org}),PERSON_ID=COALESCE(PERSON_ID,#{person,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),PERSON_PROOF_PHASE_ID=COALESCE(PERSON_PROOF_PHASE_ID,#{proof,jdbcType=NUMERIC}) WHERE ID=#{p.id} AND STATE='PREPARED' AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{p.leaseToken} AND (PERSON_OPERATION_KEY IS NULL OR PERSON_OPERATION_KEY=#{operation}) AND (PERSON_IDENTITY_HASH IS NULL OR PERSON_IDENTITY_HASH=#{hash}) AND (ORG_INDEX_CODE IS NULL OR ORG_INDEX_CODE=#{org}) AND (PERSON_ID IS NULL OR PERSON_ID=#{person,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (PERSON_PROOF_PHASE_ID IS NULL OR PERSON_PROOF_PHASE_ID=#{proof,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_ROUTE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_SCHEDULER_ROUTE WHERE PARK_ID=#{p.parkId} AND ACCESS_TYPE='ISC' AND INSTANCE_ID=#{p.instanceId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_IDENTITY I USING(SELECT #{p.instanceId} INSTANCE_ID,#{person} PERSON_ID FROM DUAL) S ON(I.INSTANCE_ID=S.INSTANCE_ID AND I.PERSON_ID=S.PERSON_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(INSTANCE_ID,PERSON_ID,SUBJECT_TYPE,SUBJECT_ID,PARK_ID,PHASE_ID,CREATE_TIME) VALUES(S.INSTANCE_ID,S.PERSON_ID,#{p.subjectType},#{p.subjectId},#{p.parkId},#{p.id},SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_IDENTITY WHERE INSTANCE_ID=#{p.instanceId} AND PERSON_ID=#{person} AND SUBJECT_TYPE=#{p.subjectType} AND SUBJECT_ID=#{p.subjectId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A SET STATUS='EXPIRED',ERROR_CODE='WAITING_RESOURCE_OWNER',UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{c.attemptId} AND TARGET_ID=#{c.targetId} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{c.leaseToken} AND STATUS='CLAIMED' AND TASK_ID IS NULL AND EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID IS NULL AND EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_TRANSPORT_PHASE P WHERE P.ATTEMPT_ID=A.ID) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET T WHERE T.ID=A.TARGET_ID AND T.LEASE_TOKEN=#{c.leaseToken} AND T.STATE='EXECUTING')

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET SET STATE='QUEUED',LEASE_TOKEN=NULL,LEASE_UNTIL=NULL,NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP)+INTERVAL '5' SECOND,UPDATE_TIME=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE ID=#{c.targetId} AND LEASE_TOKEN=#{c.leaseToken} AND STATE='EXECUTING' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT A WHERE A.ID=#{c.attemptId} AND A.TARGET_ID=#{c.targetId} AND A.STATUS='EXPIRED' AND A.ERROR_CODE='WAITING_RESOURCE_OWNER')
